runtime_resources_profile.upstream_mapping: The reviewed BoolODE YAML exposes only a do_parallel boolean; the pinned implementation calls multiprocessing.Pool() without a process-count argument and hard-codes KMeans n_jobs=8. The wrapper therefore rejects runtime_resources.threads != 1, writes do_parallel=false, and patches the imported public BoolODE KMeans constructor to n_jobs=1 before calling BoolODE.ConfigParser.parse(...).execute_jobs().

provenance.timing_scope: docker run wall time including container startup and output writing
